abort.already_configured: A Wolt account is already configured. Remove the legacy YAML block after it has been imported.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Wolt. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_response: Wolt returned an unsupported response. The private API may have changed.

user.title: Connect Wolt
user.description: Enter a Wolt refresh token. The access token and analytics session ID are optional. Credentials are tested before they are saved. Venue IDs are slugs from venue URLs; separate multiple IDs by new lines.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Wolt
reauth_confirm.description: Wolt rejected the saved credentials. Enter a current refresh token from wolt.com. The access token is optional. The analytics session ID is optional; leave it blank to keep the saved value.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Wolt. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_response: Wolt returned an unsupported response. The private API may have changed.

init.title: Update Wolt settings
init.description: Update tokens or venue IDs. Leave access and refresh tokens blank to keep their current values. The analytics session ID is optional; leaving it blank clears it. Venue IDs are slugs from the venue URL; separate multiple IDs by new lines.

data.tracking_maps: Enable location attributes for all orders
data.destination_home: Use Home as a destination reference

data_description.tracking_maps: Publishes courier/pickup coordinates to Home Assistant history. Off by default; legacy locations are preserved only for their existing order. Turning this off removes location attributes.
data_description.destination_home: Requires locations enabled. This is your Home zone, not a verified delivery address from Wolt. Leave off for orders sent elsewhere.
